CONVERTIBLE LOAN AGREEMENT

This Convertible Loan Agreement is entered into as of December 1, 2023
by and between ACMECORP LTD., an Israeli company (the "Company"), and
Foobar Israel Fund LP (the "Lender").

1. PRINCIPAL. The Lender agrees to lend the Company a principal amount
of US $200,000 (the "Principal Amount").

2. INTEREST. The Principal Amount shall bear interest at the rate
prescribed by Section 3(j) of the Israeli Income Tax Regulations, as
published by the Israeli Tax Authority from time to time. No fixed
numeric interest rate shall be applied; the statutory rate shall govern.

3. MATURITY. The Maturity Date shall be December 1, 2025 (24 months
from the date hereof).

4. CONVERSION. Upon a Qualified Financing (defined as an equity round of
at least $1,000,000), the Principal Amount plus accrued interest shall
convert into shares at a Valuation Cap of $8,000,000, with a Discounted
Price equal to 80% of the per-share price of the Qualified Financing
(i.e., a 20% effective discount).

5. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the
State of Israel.
